label: For "On-Call Runbook Assistant": Find the right runbook for an alert, summarise the steps in context and answer questions during an incident, with links to the source and no actions taken without approval. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Model memory of procedures.
